title: Guardrails
description: A comprehensive input/output guardrails filter for AI safety.
Checks questions before they reach the LLM (prompt injection, topic restriction,
input length) and checks answers after the LLM responds (hallucination detection,
content safety, PII leak detection, format compliance).</br>
Policy modes: block (reject violations), warn (log and continue), log (silent logging).

strict.title: Strict: All checks enabled, block on violation

policy_mode.title: Policy mode
policy_mode.description: How to handle violations: block (reject), warn (log + continue), log (silent)

enable_prompt_injection.title: Enable prompt injection detection
enable_prompt_injection.description: Detect and flag prompt injection attempts in input

enable_content_safety.title: Enable content safety check
enable_content_safety.description: Detect harmful or unsafe content in output

enable_pii_detection.title: Enable PII detection
enable_pii_detection.description: Detect personal identifiable information (emails, phones, SSNs, credit cards) in output

enable_hallucination_check.title: Enable hallucination check
enable_hallucination_check.description: Verify that output claims are grounded in source documents

max_input_length.title: Max input length (chars)
max_input_length.description: Maximum character count for input text (0 = no limit)

max_tokens_estimate.title: Max tokens (estimate)
max_tokens_estimate.description: Maximum estimated token count for input text (0 = no limit)

expected_format.title: Expected output format
expected_format.description: Validate that output matches this format (empty = no check)

blocked_topics.title: Blocked topics
blocked_topics.description: Keywords for topics that should be rejected

allowed_topics.title: Allowed topics
allowed_topics.description: If set, input must contain at least one of these keywords

enable_nonce_fencing.title: Enable nonce fencing
enable_nonce_fencing.description: Wrap untrusted input in cryptographic nonce delimiters so the LLM treats it as data, not instructions

nonce_length.title: Nonce length (bytes)
nonce_length.description: Length of the cryptographic nonce in bytes (min 16, max 128)
